definitions.short: the bosom (as comprised between the arms)
definitions.full: H2683. chetsen [ חֵ֫צֶן ] noun masculine bosom of a garment (Arabic , Ethiopic also Syriac bosom (= *), see Hoffm ZMG 1878, 753 Lag M ii. 361 ff. ; BN 46 f.; on this word and following see Ba NB 120; ZMG 1889, 183 ) — מְעַמֵּר וְחִצְנוֺ קוֺצֵר כַמּוֺ מִלֵּא שֶׁלּאֹ Psa 129:7 (grass) with which a reaper filleth not his hand, nor a binder his bosom .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to hold firmly;
